sentences.en: She bitterly regretted having said something that displeased her mother-in-law.
sentences.zh: 她后悔不该说那些让婆婆不高兴的话。

sentences.en: I don't think she'll be happy living with her mother-in-law.
sentences.zh: 我觉得和岳母一起生活她不会开心的。

sentences.en: Speak to the daughter-in-law so that the mother-in-law may understand.
sentences.zh: 跟儿媳谈谈，好让婆婆理解。
